requirements.title: Load Webinar Registrants
requirements.definition: Load approximately 8,800 registrants through the specified webinar registration page within the requested 24-hour task period.
requirements.boundary_note: The registration target, approximate volume, and 24-hour deadline are attributes of one bounded data-entry deliverable; network-origin constraints are independently enforceable and remain separate.

requirements.title: Use Rotating US IP Addresses
requirements.definition: Perform webinar registrations using only US IP addresses and switch addresses frequently to reduce platform blocking.
requirements.boundary_note: US-only origin and frequent address rotation are parameters of one network-access mechanism rather than separate Requirements; registrant-volume completion is independently assessable.
